turns.text: [GE-OMITTED:21:aa] [GE-OMITTED:22:aa]

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, do not talk like this, you are not finished with anything yet, and you will get well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not get well, and I must see my son married and settled before I go, so that he will not be a burden to you.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry about me, I will take care of Father and myself, and I will marry a good woman when the time is right.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see you married, and I want to see the woman you choose to be a good mother to my grandchildren.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: Excuse me, Mother, but I have been thinking, and I would like to help with the arrangements for the son's wedding.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: You are a good girl, and I appreciate your offer, but this is a matter for the family to decide.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: I will take care of the wedding arrangements, O-lan, you just rest and get well.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I will not get well, and I must see this through, so that my son will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry, I will take care of myself, and I will make sure that Father takes care of you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see you happy, and I want to see you with a good woman by your side.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: May I suggest a match with the daughter of the neighboring farmer, she is a good girl and would make a suitable wife for the son.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: That is a good idea, but I want to see the woman for myself, before I give my approval.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you are tired, and you need to rest, I will take care of everything.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I am not tired, and I must see this through, so that my son will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: the eldest son
turns.text: Mother, do not worry, I will take care of everything, and I will make sure that Father takes care of you.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: I want to see you happy, and I want to see you with a good woman by your side.

turns.speaker: the maid
turns.text: I will make sure that the preparations for the wedding are made, and that everything is ready for the son's new life.

turns.speaker: O-lan
turns.text: Thank you, girl, you are a good help to me, and I am content that everything will be taken care of.

turns.speaker: Wang Lung
turns.text: O-lan, you are a good wife and mother, and I will take care of everything, do not worry.
